description: This file contains the implementation of the 'Template' class within the 'Opencart\System\Library\Template' namespace. It provides methods for managing template paths, rendering templates, and compiling template code for the OpenCart platform.

classes.name: Template
classes.description: A class responsible for managing template rendering, path management, and template compilation within the OpenCart framework.

methods.name: addPath
methods.description: Adds a namespace-to-directory mapping for templates.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders a template file with provided data, optionally using a specific code version.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles template code into a PHP cache file for faster subsequent loads.
